description:
The warrior Kang Na-Ru, who became a NEET after his divorce, decides to become an academy professor to change. However, the students keep on pushing themselves onto him, even with the memories of divorce still fresh in his head…!

*“I keep having lewd thoughts whenever I see you, Professor!”*

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
